extra.reason: Implemented tygo-based TypeScript protocol generation, preserved the $lib/types wrapper, and verified Go and web checks.
Fixed fake-agent pending approval collisions by deriving request IDs from the session ID, and added regression coverage for two fake sessions on one store.

Composer on the session detail page: sendInput command (valibot {id,text}) POSTs hub /sessions/{id}/input; sent text renders via the live stream as input_received (no optimistic insert). Enter sends / Shift+Enter newline, disabled while empty/pending, inline errors (e.g. 409 'session is not active'), composer hidden when session finished. Passing check/lint; live verification pending a running hostd/agent.
Implemented web approval cards with approve, deny, and inline reply actions; verified with lint and type checks.
